en.headline: Wear's HK designer pop-ups run at six sites through mid-September
en.dek: Twenty Hong Kong labels are in temporary shops at Harbour City, ifc mall, Pacific Place, Hysan Place, Festival Walk and the airport until 14 September.
body: Wear's HK, a citywide pop-up programme under the government-presented Hong Kong Fashion Fest, remains open at six retail sites through 14 September. The Clothing Industry Training Authority organises the project with sponsorship from the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency.

Twenty Hong Kong designer labels are showing work at Harbour City in Tsim Sha Tsui, ifc mall in Central, Harvey Nichols at Pacific Place, Hysan Place in Causeway Bay, Festival Walk in Kowloon Tong and a landside-restricted shop in Terminal 1 at Hong Kong International Airport. Most mall sites keep 11am-to-8pm hours; the airport shop is listed as 7am to 11pm. Festival Walk is scheduled only from 8 to 13 September, and Hysan Place from 2 to 13 September.

The same designers also appear in a free display at the Common Arcade on the first floor of Jardine House in Central, open 9am to 6pm until 14 September, as part of Fashion Summit (HK) 2026. Hong Kong Fashion Fest as a whole runs from 1 to 14 September.

Organisers said the pop-ups are intended to put local labels in front of shoppers and visitors during the two-week festival. The Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau has described Fashion Fest as part of an effort to present Hong Kong as a regional fashion-design centre.

zh.headline: 「Wear's HK」六區時裝快閃店開至9月14日
zh.dek: 香港時裝薇項目於海港城、ifc、太古廣場、希慎、又一城及機場設20個本地設計師快閃點，部分點只開至本周末。
body: 由特區政府主辦的香港時裝薇旗下項目「Wear's HK」快閃店仍於全港六個零售點開放至9月14日。項目由製衣業訓練局主辦，文創產業發展處贊助。
20個香港設計師品牌分別進駐尖沙嘲海港城港威商場大堂、中環ifc mall、金鐘太古廣場Harvey Nichols、銅鑼灣希慎廣場、九龍塘又一城，以及香港國際機場一號客運大樓離港層禁區店舖。商場點大多由上午11時開至晚上8時，機場店公布時間為上午7時至晚上11時。又一城只由9月8日至13日開放，希慎廣場則由9月2日至13日。
同一批設計師作品亦在中環怡和大廈一樓公共走廊的「時尚高峰（香港）2026」展覽展出，開放時間上午9時至下午6時，至9月14日，免費入場。香港時裝薇整體活動期為9月1日至14日。
主辦單位指快閃店是在為期兩周的時裝薇期間，讓本地設計師品牌接觸市民及旅客。文化體育及旅遊局形容時裝薇是展示香港作為區域時裝設計中心的工作之一。
